# Floating Callout on Hover

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(vistime)
library(highcharter)

# Define timeline events as a list of lists
timeline_data <- list(
  list(
    name = "Project Kickoff",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Initial alignment meeting and scoping."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Alpha Release",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Core features deployed for internal review."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Beta Testing",
    date = "2026-08-01",
    description = "User acceptance testing and bug fixes."
  ),
  list(
    name = "Official Launch",
    date = "2026-11-20",
    description = "Public rollout and deployment."
  )
)

# Build the timeline chart
highchart() %>% 
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>% 
  hc_title(text = "Project Timeline Example") %>% 
  hc_add_series(
    data = timeline_data,
    name = "Timeline Events"
  )



```

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(highcharter)

# Define timeline data including superposed start milestones and intervals
superposed_timeline_data <- list(
  # --- Phase 1 & its starting Milestone ---
  list(
    name = "Milestone: Kickoff",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Zero-duration start milestone.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-01-15")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "circle",     # Zero-duration circle marker
      radius = 9,
      fillColor = "#f45b5b",
      lineWidth = 2,
      lineColor = "#FFFFFF"
    )
  ),
  list(
    name = "Phase 1: Architecture & Setup",
    date = "2026-01-15",
    description = "Duration interval block following kickoff.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-01-15")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "square",     # Rectangular base timeline block
      radius = 7,
      fillColor = "#2b908f"
    )
  ),
  
  # --- Phase 2 & its starting Milestone ---
  list(
    name = "Milestone: Alpha Lock",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Zero-duration transition milestone.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-04-10")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "circle",     # Zero-duration circle marker
      radius = 9,
      fillColor = "#f45b5b",
      lineWidth = 2,
      lineColor = "#FFFFFF"
    )
  ),
  list(
    name = "Phase 2: Core Development",
    date = "2026-04-10",
    description = "Duration interval block for implementation.",
    x = datetime_to_timestamp(as.Date("2026-04-10")),
    marker = list(
      symbol = "square",     # Rectangular base timeline block
      radius = 7,
      fillColor = "#2b908f"
    )
  )
)

# Build the chart with a datetime axis to properly align superposed points
highchart() %>% 
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>% 
  hc_title(text = "Timeline with Superposed Zero-Duration Milestones at Intervals") %>% 
  hc_xAxis(type = "datetime") %>% 
  hc_add_series(
    data = superposed_timeline_data,
    name = "Roadmap Schedule"
  )

```




```{r eval=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Prepare historical blocks/events data spanning -3000 to 2100
timeline_data <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Early Bronze Age", 
    "Classical Antiquity", 
    "Middle Ages", 
    "Modern Era", 
    "Contemporary Era"
  ),
  label = c(
    "-3000 BC: Civilization rises", 
    "500 BC: Rise of Empires", 
    "500 AD: Medieval Period", 
    "1500 AD: Age of Discovery", 
    "2000+ AD: Digital Age"
  ),
  description = c(
    "Emergence of writing systems, early bronze metallurgy, and first major city-states in Mesopotamia and Egypt.",
    "Dominated by Greco-Roman civilization, the Han Dynasty, and major philosophical shifts across Eurasia.",
    "Characterized by feudalism, major religious expansions, and significant architectural feats.",
    "Marked by the scientific revolution, industrialization, and global exploration.",
    "Defined by rapid technological advancement, information age, and space exploration."
  ),
  x = c(-3000, -500, 500, 1500, 2000) # Numeric year mapping (negative for BCE)
)

# 2. Build the Highcharter Timeline
highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>%
  hc_title(text = "World History Timeline (-3000 to 2100)") %>%
  hc_subtitle(text = "Interactive chronological blocks across millennia") %>%
  hc_add_series(
    data = timeline_data,
    type = "timeline",
    hcaes(x = x, name = name, label = label, description = description),
    dataLabels = list(
      allowOverlap = TRUE,
      format = '<b>{point.name}</b><br>{point.label}'
    )
  ) %>%
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    headerFormat = "",
    pointFormat = '<b>{point.name} ({point.x})</b><br>{point.description}'
  ) %>%
  hc_xAxis(
    type = "linear",
    title = list(text = "Year (Negative = BCE, Positive = CE)")
  )



```

```{r}
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)

string <- "Période	Dates approximatives	Événements / Figures clés
Patriarches	2000–1600 av. J.-C.	Abraham, Isaac, Jacob ; installation en Canaan ; Joseph en Égypte
Séjour en Égypte & Exode	1600–1200 av. J.-C.	Esclavage ; Moïse ; sortie d’Égypte ; Sinaï ; conquête de Canaan (Josué)
Juges	1200–1020 av. J.-C.	Organisation tribale 
; Débora, Gédéon, Samson ; instabilité
Monarchie unifiée	1020–930 av. J.-C.	Saül ; David ; Salomon ; construction du Temple
Monarchie divisée (Israël & Juda)	930–586 av. J.-C.	Royaumes séparés ; prophètes (Élie, Isaïe, Jérémie…)
Exil à Babylone	586–538 av. J.-C.	Destruction du Temple ; déportation ; Ézéchiel, Daniel
Retour d’exil & période perse	538–332 av. J.-C.	Édit de Cyrus ; reconstruction du Temple ; Esdras, Néhémie
Période hellénistique	332–164 av. J.-C.	Alexandre le Grand ; domination grecque ; tensions religieuses
Période hasmonéenne	164–63 av. J.-C.	Révolte des Maccabées ; indépendance juive ; dynastie hasmonéenne
Période romaine	63 av. J.-C. – 70 ap. J.-C.	Pompée ; Hérode ; naissance et ministère de Jésus ; destruction du Temple"

library(tibble)

timeline_israel <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,                         ~label,                      ~description,                                           ~x,
  "Patriarches",                    "2000–1600 av. J.-C.",       "Abraham, Isaac, Jacob; Joseph en Égypte",            -1800,
  "Séjour en Égypte & Exode",       "1600–1200 av. J.-C.",       "Moïse; sortie d'Égypte; Sinaï; Josué",               -1400,
  "Juges",                          "1200–1020 av. J.-C.",       "Organisation tribale; Débora; Gédéon; Samson",       -1110,
  "Monarchie unifiée",              "1020–930 av. J.-C.",        "Saül; David; Salomon; Temple",                       -975,
  "Monarchie divisée",              "930–586 av. J.-C.",         "Israël & Juda; Élie; Isaïe; Jérémie",                -758,
  "Exil à Babylone",                "586–538 av. J.-C.",         "Destruction du Temple; Ézéchiel; Daniel",            -562,
  "Retour d'exil & période perse",  "538–332 av. J.-C.",         "Cyrus; reconstruction du Temple; Esdras; Néhémie",   -435,
  "Période hellénistique",          "332–164 av. J.-C.",         "Alexandre; Séleucides; tensions religieuses",        -248,
  "Période hasmonéenne",            "164–63 av. J.-C.",          "Maccabées; indépendance; Hasmonéens",                -113.5,
  "Période romaine",                "63 av. J.-C.–70 ap. J.-C.", "Pompée; Hérode; naissance et ministère de Jésus",     3.5
)

# 2. Build the Highcharter Timeline
highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "timeline") %>%
  hc_title(text = "World History Timeline (-3000 to 2100)") %>%
  hc_subtitle(text = "Interactive chronological blocks across millennia") %>%
  hc_add_series(
    data = timeline_israel,
    type = "timeline",
    hcaes(x = x, name = name, label = label, description = description),
    dataLabels = list(
      allowOverlap = TRUE,
      format = '<b>{point.name}</b><br>{point.label}'
    )
  ) %>%
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    headerFormat = "",
    pointFormat = '<b>{point.name} ({point.x})</b><br>{point.description}'
  ) %>%
  hc_xAxis(
    type = "linear",
    title = list(text = "Year (Negative = BCE, Positive = CE)")
  )

```
